title: 2023-2024 Retail Sales Performance Report
executive_summary: Total revenue for 2023-2024 reached $445,325.09 across 520 orders, yielding an average order value of $856.39. The business achieved 10.1% year-over-year revenue growth, with the East region leading regional performance. Revenue in 2024 trended upward through Q3 before a slight Q4 moderation. High-discount electronics orders contributed $50,035.33, while customer concentration remains moderate with the top customer accounting for 6.2% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: Overall performance totaled $445,325.09 in revenue from 520 orders, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
The East region generated the highest revenue at $130,516.69, followed by North at $124,845.75, West at $99,428.16, and South at $90,534.49.
2024 quarterly revenue rose from $36,108.31 in Q1 to a peak of $71,674.99 in Q3, before settling at $68,948.71 in Q4.
Revenue increased 10.1% year-over-year, rising from $211,976.29 in 2023 to $233,348.80 in 2024.
There were 22 high-discount Electronics orders (discount ≥20%), generating $50,035.33 in total revenue.
Order revenue distribution had a mean of $856.39 and median of $313.28, with a sample standard deviation of $1,295.74, ranging from $5.27 to $7,844.02.
The customer base comprised 222 unique customers, with the top customer contributing $27,793.13, representing 6.2% of total revenue.

limitations: The analysis covers only 2023-2024 data; trends may not persist in future periods.
Data quality depends on the cleaning stage; any systematic errors in order categorization or dating could affect regional and quarterly breakdowns.
Customer concentration analysis identifies only the top customer; it does not assess broader concentration among the top 5 or 10 customers.
conclusion: The business shows healthy growth with a 10.1% year-over-year revenue increase and strong performance in the East and North regions. The 2024 quarterly trend suggests momentum through Q3, though Q4's slight dip warrants monitoring. High-discount Electronics orders contribute meaningfully at 11.2% of total revenue. The right-skewed revenue distribution indicates a mix of small and large orders, and customer concentration risk appears manageable with no single customer exceeding 7% of revenue.
